restaurants.name: North Italia
restaurants.address: 401 The Bridge St NW, Suite 180, Huntsville, AL 35806
restaurants.summary: Buttery truffle garlic bread, fresh margherita pizza, creamy tripoline alfredo and tiramisu. What to order at North Italia, Bridge Street Town Centre.

restaurants.name: The Cheesecake Factory
restaurants.address: 300 The Bridge St NW, Suite 110, Huntsville, AL 35806
restaurants.summary: We tried the viral Louisiana Chicken Pasta and Cajun Salmon with extra sauce, plus a mango margarita. What to order at The Cheesecake Factory, Huntsville.

restaurants.name: Entice Bar & Grille
restaurants.summary: Our pick for best wings in Madison: 50-cent wings on Wednesdays (10 minimum), hot lemon pepper, and happy hour until 8pm. All under $40 at Entice.

restaurants.name: Tacos de Canasta Acapulco
restaurants.address: 7192 Wall Triana Hwy, Suite A, Madison, AL 35757
restaurants.summary: The chicken gorditas are the star: crispy tortilla and flavorful chicken. Plus steak tacos and nachos at this cheap, quick-lunch Mexican spot in Madison.

restaurants.name: Viet Crispwich
restaurants.summary: Crispy shredded chicken banh mi, fried pork dumplings and loaded spicy chili broth noodles. What to order at Viet Crispwich in Huntsville.

restaurants.name: Handel's Ice Cream
restaurants.summary: Handel's limited-time Cheesecake with Biscoff Cookies ice cream: cheesecake base, cookie butter swirl and crunchy cookie pieces. Try it in Huntsville.

restaurants.name: Loona's Cafe
restaurants.address: 20 Town Center Dr NW, Ste 1109, Huntsville, AL 35806
restaurants.summary: Brunch at Loona's Cafe in Providence, Huntsville: Nashville Hot Chicken Bennie, salmon and grits, breakfast burrito, avocado toast and mimosas.

restaurants.name: LOUIMA Haitian Cuisine (food truck)
restaurants.summary: Fried snapper, vegetable stew, jerk chicken and pikliz from Chef Kay's Haitian food truck in Madison. Five stars from us. Opens after 4pm.

restaurants.name: LawLer's Barbecue
restaurants.address: 11310 S Memorial Pkwy SW, Suite A, Huntsville, AL 35803
restaurants.bestDish: Loaded potato with pulled chicken or pork
restaurants.summary: Two Potato Tuesdays at LawLer's Barbecue: two huge loaded potatoes with pulled chicken or pork for $16. One of the best cheap eats in Huntsville.

restaurants.name: Jet's Pizza
restaurants.address: 1079 Balch Rd, Suite I, Madison, AL
restaurants.summary: Jet's Pizza on Balch Rd in Madison: 4 Corner Deep Dish, crispy thin crust, buffalo and BBQ wings, and house-made ranch you should not skip. Our take.

restaurants.name: La Parrilla Mexican Restaurant
restaurants.address: 461 John Henry Way, Ste 1080, Madison, AL 35757
restaurants.summary: Mexican food at Clift Farm in Madison for under $60: house margaritas, tableside guacamole, fried fish tacos and the famous Sopa de Pollo. Our honest take.

restaurants.name: The Spot
restaurants.address: 1605 Pulaski Pike NW, Ste 3, Huntsville, AL 35816
restaurants.summary: Our go-to for a night out: good catfish, wings, $2 drink specials and hookah at affordable prices. What to order at The Spot on Pulaski Pike in Huntsville.

restaurants.name: Kyuramen
restaurants.address: 5850 University Dr NW, Suite D2, Huntsville, AL 35806
restaurants.summary: What to order at Kyuramen in Huntsville: extra hot Kyushu Spicy Tonkotsu Ramen, the yakitori platter, popcorn chicken, and matcha and s'mores tiramisu.

restaurants.name: West End Grill
restaurants.address: 6610 Old Madison Pike Unit 109, Huntsville, AL 35806
restaurants.summary: A Huntsville staple and cheap date: lemon pepper and Jamaican jerk wings, a juicy patty melt and homemade ranch, all under $60. What to order here.

restaurants.name: Pico Fresh Mex
restaurants.address: 1947 Blake Bottom Rd NW, Huntsville, AL 35806
restaurants.summary: Birria pizza is our favorite, plus fish tacos with pickled onions, nachos, quesadillas and margarita pitchers. Our weekly Mexican spot in Monrovia.

restaurants.name: Scoop & Slice Cafe
restaurants.address: 30029 Capshaw Rd, Suite B, Harvest, AL 35749
restaurants.summary: Temporarily closed. Our regular Harvest spot for Philly cheesesteak pizza with Alfredo, a loaded Italian club, fresh seasoned fries and ice cream samples.

restaurants.name: Pan-Z-Effie's
restaurants.summary: Fried catfish we rate 1000/10, plus ribs, wings and mac and cheese from this Huntsville soul food and BBQ truck on Pulaski Pike. Open Wed to Sat after 4pm.

restaurants.name: Parlor Doughnuts
restaurants.summary: Three savory pizza doughnuts: Buffalo Chicken, Chicken Bacon Ranch and OG Pepperoni. We gave them 10 out of 10. Parlor Doughnuts, Clinton Ave, Huntsville.

restaurants.name: Rooster's
restaurants.summary: A quick drive-thru stop in Athens: the sauce was the star, then the tenders, fries and sweet tea. A little pricey, but honestly worth it.

restaurants.name: Osteria Luca
restaurants.address: 3414 Governors Dr SW, Suite 705, Huntsville, AL 35805
restaurants.summary: The hot honey meatball pizza was the one, plus a crispy Caesar salad and chicken mushroom fettuccine alfredo. Italian near Stovehouse in Huntsville.

restaurants.name: Barracuda Taco Stand
restaurants.summary: Made-to-order tacos on Meridian St: a juicy pork taco with pickled onions was our favorite, plus chicken and crispy fish tacos and a 10/10 lime margarita.

restaurants.name: Dragon Alley
restaurants.summary: Yaki udon we'd go back for, soft duck bao and earthy cocktails, plus karaoke and a nightly DJ. Our honest review of Dragon Alley in MidCity, Huntsville.

restaurants.name: Viet House
restaurants.address: 975 Airport Rd SW, Ste B2, Huntsville, AL 35802
restaurants.summary: Our forever-favorite pho spot: spicy chicken pho, fried spring rolls and pork dumplings, all under $40. What to order at Viet House in Huntsville.

restaurants.name: Hattie B's Hot Chicken
restaurants.summary: Nashville hot chicken in Huntsville: medium hot tenders and wings, Dirty Bird Fries and the Poppy Seed Grilled Chicken Salad. Tastes like the original.

restaurants.name: Metro Diner
restaurants.address: 975 Airport Rd SW Ste 20-22, Huntsville, AL 35802
restaurants.summary: Loaded fries, crispy fish and chips and steak tips with mashed potatoes, all under $50. Breakfast is served at dinner too at Metro Diner in Huntsville.

restaurants.name: Steam Boys
restaurants.summary: One of our favorites in Madison: beef bao, cheeseburger dumplings, popcorn chicken and passion fruit boba. All-you-can-eat dumplings Thursdays for $20.

restaurants.name: Vujee Vegan
restaurants.address: 4701 Meridian St N, Ste K, Huntsville, AL 35811
restaurants.summary: Black-owned vegan spot with five-star chili, a buffalo chick'n sandwich, Philly egg rolls and waffle fries. What to order at Vujee Vegan in Huntsville.

restaurants.name: City Barbeque
restaurants.summary: Smoky wings, mac and cheese with a real cheese pull, and meaty green beans, about $32 for two. What to order at City Barbeque in South Huntsville.

restaurants.name: Cooper's Hawk
restaurants.summary: Worth the hype at Clift Farm: prime rib sandwich, surf and turf, chicken potstickers and a 10/10 s'mores budino. What to order at Cooper's Hawk in Madison.

restaurants.name: Hunnydew Bakery
restaurants.summary: We gave Hunnydew Bakery a 10 out of 10. Cinnamon sparkle, chocolate lava and velvet dreams cookies from a Black-owned, gluten-friendly Huntsville baker.

restaurants.name: Blue Oak BBQ
restaurants.summary: BBQ in MidCity with daily specials, margaritas and beer-battered tots. We got the Winter Burger, mild buffalo wings and baked beans, and want to go back.

restaurants.name: Jon Smith Subs
restaurants.address: 11156 County Line Rd, Ste G, Madison, AL 35756
restaurants.summary: Get the hot Cajun chicken sandwich at Jon Smith Subs in Madison: cheesy, fresh and hot. Weekday $10 sandwich, chips and drink deal on County Line Rd.

restaurants.name: Sunnyside Pizzeria
restaurants.address: 220 Sandy Springs Cir NE, Suite 149, Sandy Springs, GA 30328
restaurants.summary: A road-trip pick near Atlanta: the Honey Hot Pizza with pepperoni is fresh, cheesy and sweet-hot. Alfredo pasta, spritz drinks and gelato in Sandy Springs.

restaurants.name: Chikin Jip
restaurants.address: 12120 County Line Rd, Suite A, Madison, AL 35756
restaurants.summary: Spicy yangnyeom boneless chicken with fries and bulgogi fries. Fresh food and friendly service. What to order at Chikin Jip in Madison, AL.

restaurants.name: Chuck's Fish
restaurants.address: 461 John Henry Way, Bldg 500, Madison, AL 35757
restaurants.summary: Date night at Clift Farm: five-star hot honey pizza, salmon sushi and parmesan-crusted grouper. Pricey but worth it. Chuck's Fish in Madison.

restaurants.name: One Eleven
restaurants.summary: Shareable cocktails, a fresh wedge salad, fish, mussels, pasta and steak, plus a photo booth. Our take on One Eleven for date night in downtown Huntsville.

restaurants.name: Wings & Gyros
restaurants.summary: Some of the best wings in Huntsville: hot lemon pepper and hot honey wings, fresh fries and really good ice cream. Our take on Wings & Gyros near UAH.

restaurants.name: Taqueria Las Adelitas
restaurants.summary: Get the fish taco: one of the best tacos we've ever had. We also liked the chips and salsa. What to order at Taqueria Las Adelitas in Huntsville.

restaurants.name: Daylight Donuts
restaurants.summary: Chocolate glazed donuts, cinnamon rolls and donut holes, plus breakfast sandwiches and pigs in a blanket. What to order at Daylight Donuts, Huntsville.

restaurants.name: Fluffy Fluffy
restaurants.address: 2338 Whitesburg Dr, Ste B, Huntsville, AL 35801
restaurants.summary: Fluffy matcha souffle pancakes, lattes and cheesecake on Whitesburg Dr. Sweet, cozy and worth the stop. What to order at Fluffy Fluffy in Huntsville.

restaurants.name: P.F. Chang's
restaurants.address: 305 The Bridge St, Suite 101, Huntsville, AL 35806
restaurants.summary: We worked through seven dishes at P.F. Chang's at Bridge Street Town Centre in Huntsville. Order the spicy chicken and garlic noodles. Good for groups.

restaurants.name: Playa Bowls
restaurants.address: 460 John Henry Way, Suite 390, Madison, AL 35758
restaurants.summary: Our pick for something cold: the Aloha Smoothie with protein and chia, plus the Acai Nutella Bowl. What to order at Playa Bowls, Clift Farm, Madison.

restaurants.name: Field Day
restaurants.address: 6123 University Dr NW, Unit 110, Huntsville, AL 35806
alsoOrder: Appetizer platter (onion rings, chips and salsa, mozzarella bites)
restaurants.summary: Mini golf, axe throwing, bowling and a big patio for game days, plus pizza, wings and fish bowl drinks. Our take on Field Day on University Dr in Huntsville.

restaurants.name: Las Trojas Cantina
restaurants.address: 14739 Hwy 231-431 N, Suite H, Hazel Green, AL 35750
restaurants.summary: Birria tacos, birria pizza, carne asada fries and the big Bama margarita at Las Trojas Cantina in Hazel Green. Great for birthdays and large groups.

restaurants.name: Mozza
restaurants.summary: Pepperoni and sausage pizza, pasta and calzones, fast and fresh out of the oven. Mozza on Jordan Ln is in our top 3 for pizza in Huntsville.

restaurants.name: Mi Tierra Oaxaqueña
restaurants.summary: Chicken and steak tacos on corn and flour tortillas got a great rating from us. What to order at Mi Tierra Oaxaqueña on Pulaski Pike in Huntsville.

restaurants.name: The Biscuit Express
restaurants.summary: A bacon, egg and cheese biscuit with crisp bacon and a chicken biscuit that reminded us of Jack's. What to order at The Biscuit Express on Moores Mill Rd.

restaurants.name: Mo'Bay Beignet Co.
restaurants.summary: Fresh beignets with syrups, a crispy club chicken sandwich, burgers and coffee. A new Monrovia spot on Jeff Rd in Huntsville with room to sit and work.

restaurants.name: Taqueria Doña Vale
restaurants.summary: Shredded chicken tacos, steak tacos on fresh homemade tortillas and a thick chicken sope, inside a gas station. What to order at Taqueria Doña Vale.

restaurants.name: Taqueria Don Pancho
restaurants.summary: Crispy, not-soggy birria tacos, a torta mamalona big enough for two, and steak and chicken tacos. What to order at Taqueria Don Pancho in Madison, AL.

restaurants.name: Floyd's Barbecue
restaurants.summary: Five stars and the best pork sandwich in Huntsville. Get the pork sandwich plate with baked beans and a juicy rib. What to order at Floyd's Barbecue.

restaurants.name: Super Chix
restaurants.address: 100 Moon Shot Dr, Suite 100, Madison, AL 35758
restaurants.summary: Big portions by Toyota Field: crispy chicken tenders, a buffalo chicken sandwich, and loaded fries with bacon and queso. Our take on Super Chix in Madison.

restaurants.name: Teriyaki Express Grill (food truck)
restaurants.summary: A Madison food truck at Capshaw and Wall Triana: fried gyoza and a chicken teriyaki plate for about $15. What to order at Teriyaki Express Grill.

restaurants.name: Niyah's Southern Grill
restaurants.address: 1392 Jordan Rd, Suite D, Huntsville, AL 35811
restaurants.summary: Crispy, well-seasoned fried catfish was our favorite, plus porkchop bites, hot wings, queso mac and homemade white sauce at this Huntsville soul food spot.

restaurants.name: Nicas Grill & Café (food truck)
restaurants.summary: Nicaraguan-American fusion food truck. The loaded fries taste like Philly cheese fries, and the Valenciana rice is next. Find it at Orion and NASA Corral.

restaurants.name: LJ'z Backyard Bayou
restaurants.address: 3155 Old Railroad Bed Rd, Harvest, AL 35749
restaurants.summary: Cajun and Creole food in Harvest, AL: jambalaya, shellfish-free gumbo, fried catfish and Sunday beignets. Open Friday to Sunday only. Black-owned.

restaurants.name: Melt
restaurants.address: 201 Jefferson St N Ste I, Huntsville, AL 35801
restaurants.summary: Tater tots, mac and cheese egg rolls, fried chicken sandwiches and mimosa pitchers. Our go-to for years at Melt in downtown Huntsville.

restaurants.name: Rosie's
restaurants.summary: A decent Tex-Mex spot on University Drive: Rotel dip, steak nachos, a beef taco and a margarita. Our honest take on Rosie's in Huntsville.

restaurants.name: Mi Delicioso Guanajuato
restaurants.address: 2818 Governors Dr SW Ste C, Huntsville, AL 35805
restaurants.summary: Quesabirrias with consomé, chicken tacos and flautas con pollo, all hot and fresh. What to order at Mi Delicioso Guanajuato on Governors Dr in Huntsville.

restaurants.name: Aloha Ramen House
restaurants.address: 1591 Hughes Rd Ste C, Madison, AL 35758
restaurants.summary: Comfort food in Madison: fried gyoza, crispy chicken katsu and spicy tonkotsu ramen with chicken or pork, plus a yuzu white peach drink. What to order.

restaurants.name: Beignets & Brew
restaurants.address: 12120 County Line Rd, Suite C, Madison, AL 35756
restaurants.summary: A caramel latte and beignets with chocolate sauce at Beignets & Brew on County Line Rd in Madison. It is just up the street, so we might go too often.

restaurants.name: Lyli Viet-Thai Cuisine (Phomous)
restaurants.address: 7407 Hwy 72 W, Ste D, Madison, AL 35758
restaurants.summary: Chicken gyoza, chicken pho with add-ins and really spicy lemongrass chicken. What to order at Lyli Viet-Thai Cuisine, also called Phomous, in Madison.

restaurants.name: Tulum Cantina
restaurants.summary: A rare sit-down spot for birria in Huntsville: birria tacos, a birria quesadilla and refreshing mango and lime margaritas. What to order at Tulum Cantina.

restaurants.name: Bo's Best Wings
restaurants.address: 3700 Blue Spring Rd NW, Unit A, Huntsville, AL 35810
restaurants.summary: Serving flavor since 1998: we got fried wings, hot lemon pepper and hot honey wings, and fried catfish with fries. Everything was so good. Our take.

restaurants.name: Pita Street Food
alsoOrder: Grilled chicken gyro combo with fries
restaurants.summary: One of our favorite grab-and-go spots in Madison. Get the grilled chicken gyro combo with fries, steak fries and raspberry lemonade at Pita Street Food.

restaurants.name: Taqueria Los 3 Reales (food truck)
restaurants.summary: Our regular South Huntsville taco truck: steak tacos, chicken tacos and sopes, with tortas next on our list. Cash only. What to order at Los 3 Reales.

restaurants.name: Taqueria Luna
restaurants.summary: Crispy, cheesy birria tacos were the star of the show, plus a birria quesadilla, steak and chicken tacos. What to order at Taqueria Luna in Madison, AL.

restaurants.name: A-Town Wings
restaurants.summary: Tiny but mighty wings in North Huntsville. We get honey gold, hot honey and hot lemon pepper, and you might need extra. What to order at A-Town Wings.

restaurants.name: MK Wings
restaurants.address: 502 Jordan Ln NW Ste A&B, Huntsville, AL 35805
restaurants.bestDish: Hot honey + hot lemon pepper wings
restaurants.summary: Hot honey and hot lemon pepper wings with a side of Cajun fries is our ultimate combo. What to order at MK Wings on Jordan Ln in Huntsville.

restaurants.name: Seoul Good
restaurants.address: 3414 Governors Dr SW, Suite 510, Huntsville, AL 35805
alsoOrder: 16-piece combo: honey mustard and sweet & spicy fried chicken
restaurants.summary: Crunchy Korean fried chicken inside Stovehouse: a 16-piece honey mustard and sweet and spicy combo with fries and cheese corn. A good date night pick.

restaurants.name: Cutes and Cupcakes
restaurants.address: 3414 Governors Dr SW, Suite 465, Huntsville, AL 35805
restaurants.summary: Chocolate Overload cupcake and Biscoff cheesecake at Stovehouse. Cakes, cookies, brownies and more. What to order at Cutes and Cupcakes in Huntsville.

restaurants.name: Los Morelenses
restaurants.summary: A gas station taqueria off Hwy 72 in Madison worth stopping for: a crispy quesadilla on a corn tortilla, chicken tacos on flour, and green and red sauce.

restaurants.name: Sac's Kitchen
restaurants.address: 6008 Mastin Lake Rd NW, Suite B, Huntsville, AL 35810
restaurants.summary: Soul food on Mastin Lake Rd: hot wings and fries, fried catfish with mac and cheese, green beans and cornbread, plus a buffet. Our take on Sac's Kitchen.

restaurants.name: Taqueria Catedral (food truck)
restaurants.summary: A good taco truck at the Chevron off Hwy 53 in Harvest. We got the steak and chicken tacos, and both were good. What to order at Taqueria Catedral.

restaurants.name: Luogo
restaurants.summary: Grilled Margherita pizza, braised short rib, duck ragu pappardelle and bomboloni. Our date night pick at Luogo in The Gulch, Nashville.

restaurants.name: Mizz Juju's
restaurants.address: 2022 Jordan Ln NW Ste B, Huntsville, AL 35816
restaurants.summary: Fried chicken sandwich, hot lemon pepper wings, honey gold wings and Ocean Water juice. The menu changes daily at Mizz Juju's on Jordan Ln in Huntsville.

restaurants.name: China Dragon
restaurants.address: 7190 Wall Triana Hwy, Ste A, Madison, AL 35757
restaurants.summary: Our go-to Chinese takeout since Michaela was a kid: General Tso's or sesame chicken with lo mein. Cheap eats at China Dragon in Madison, AL.

restaurants.name: Domaine South
restaurants.summary: Date night downtown: salmon with risotto, steak with standout duck fat fries, and cocktails. Reservations suggested. What to order at Domaine South.

restaurants.name: Big Papa Gyro
restaurants.summary: Around for 20 years on University Dr: the Big Papa Gyro, a chicken gyro, an amazing Greek salad and crispy fries, all with fresh ingredients. Our take.

restaurants.name: Big John's
restaurants.summary: In our opinion, the best fried catfish in Huntsville, plus loaded buffalo and rooftop fries. At The Open Bottle, open Thursday to Saturday, 4 to 9pm only.

restaurants.name: Luigi's Italian Grill
restaurants.summary: Lobster ravioli, chicken alfredo and grandma's lasagna that taste homemade. Our birthday dinner pick at Luigi's Italian Grill in Madison. Five stars.

restaurants.name: RD's Smokehouse Barbecue
restaurants.summary: A longtime favorite at the four-way stop off Nick Davis Rd. Get the loaded baked potato with brisket and try the wings at RD's Smokehouse in Harvest, AL.

restaurants.name: Cap's Philly Cheesesteak
restaurants.summary: A real taste of Philly inside the Nails gas station on South Memorial Pkwy. They make their own cheese whiz, and we get our cheesesteak with provolone.

restaurants.name: Little Hats Italian Market
restaurants.summary: Craving Italian in Nashville? Little Hats Italian Market in Germantown: fried ravioli, chicken parmigiana sub and meatball sub, with gluten-free buns too.

restaurants.name: Tamarind Island
restaurants.summary: A Caribbean spot at The Camp in Huntsville with jerk chicken, curry goat, seafood, fish fry and vegan options. Find Tamarind Island on University Drive.

restaurants.name: The Veggie
restaurants.summary: A Black-owned vegan spot in Madison on US-72 with salads, vegan burgers, po boys and bowls. We don't have a full review of The Veggie yet.

restaurants.name: Mia's Cafe
restaurants.address: 30697 Hwy 72 W Ste B, Madison, AL 35757
restaurants.summary: Breakfast, sandwiches, salads, soups and a Southern-style meat and three at Mia's Cafe on Hwy 72 W in Madison. Our full take on this one is still to come.

restaurants.name: The Moon Bakeshop
restaurants.summary: A downtown Huntsville bakery on Jefferson St for something sweet. We picked up a cinnamon roll and chocolate chip cookies at The Moon Bakeshop.

restaurants.name: The Ruby Slipper Cafe
alsoOrder: Sweet heat fried chicken & French toast
Fried chicken sandwich with sweet heat sauce
restaurants.summary: A nice brunch stop in Nashville: sweet heat fried chicken and French toast, plus a fried chicken sandwich with fries. What to order at Ruby Slipper.

restaurants.name: Superhero Chefs
restaurants.address: 930 Old Monrovia Rd NW, Suite 3, Huntsville, AL 35806
restaurants.summary: A Black-owned vegan breakfast and brunch spot in MidCity Huntsville with waffles, sandwiches and gluten-free options. Our take: it has tasty options.

restaurants.name: Sam & Greg's Pizzeria
restaurants.summary: A downtown Huntsville pizza spot on the square. Our pick is the sweet and spicy BBQ pizza, and you won't regret it. What to order at Sam & Greg's Pizzeria.

restaurants.name: Oh Crepe!
restaurants.address: 3414 Governors Dr SW, Suite 520, Huntsville, AL 35805
restaurants.summary: Crepes inside Stovehouse in Huntsville. We tried the BLT crepe, a savory crepe with bacon. Dessert crepes, gluten-free options and shaved ice are here too.
